_about: Titles, groups and order for the bench circuit lists. Keys are the bench names (Blueprints files drop _reactor: basic_reactor.txt is basic).

example_battery.title: Battery buffer (reactor + battery box)
example_battery.desc: Keeps batteries near 60 %, the reactor follows demand and lets the batteries soak up surplus and cover dips. Best overall; needs batteries.

reactor_modes.title: Reactive / eco modes (lever on in8)
reactor_modes.desc: Feed-forward with a mode lever. REACTIVE keeps the core at 57 degrees: the steadiest voltage of these circuits on every test file. ECO keeps it just hot enough for the load: 11-19 % fewer fuel rods, a little less steady. Pick the mode in the .circ tab: pin in8 const.1 (reactive) or const.0 (eco).

example_feedforward.title: Feed-forward (reactor only)
example_feedforward.desc: 12 parts. Turbine follows the load, fission holds 50 degrees using the turbine's real position. No batteries needed.

example_battery_naive.title: Naive battery buffer (demo)
example_battery_naive.desc: Batteries without charge management: they drain and stop helping. Kept to show why charge management matters.
